::: {.notes}
Approved scope: all of §3.4, printed pp. 59–68 of 12MAX2 – Further Vectors(1).pdf, plus the supplied Further Vectors Lesson Sequence. Students know line equations, point membership and collinearity from Lessons 3–4. They already know minimum distance from a point to a line from Extension 1; the new connection is expressing the perpendicularity condition using r(t). This is a full 20-slide deck for about 50 minutes: opening 4, 2D intersections 7, 3D consistency/skew/hinge 10, Examples 3.15–3.19 and classification 20, concurrency/distance 7, close 2. Keep all examples available and carry the final application over if needed. Complete booklet solutions in OneNote.
:::
